patterns.message: Import design-system components from the design-system barrel (index.ts), not component internals.

ds/restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().
Raw hex/px in a template literal — use design-system tokens via var().
Font not provided by the design system. Available: Nunito (var(--font-sans)).
<AlertDialog> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: tone, title, message, confirmLabel, cancelLabel, danger, onConfirm, onCancel.
<AlertDialog> tone must be one of 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info'.
